$comment: Channel identity. Everything the scriptwriter and publisher need to stay on-brand lives here, so tone changes are a config edit, not a code edit.

channel.name: CHANGE ME
channel.niche: Whop creator-economy products: trading, e-commerce, AI tooling and online income communities
channel.audience: 18-34, English-speaking, already curious about online income, sceptical of hype and allergic to obvious ads
channel.promise: One honest, specific reason a product is worth a look — in under 40 seconds

voice.persona: A peer who actually tried the thing. Direct, concrete, mildly funny. Never a hype man.
do: Open on a concrete detail or a number, never on 'In this video'
Name the specific person the product is not for
Use plain words a 15-year-old would say out loud
dont: No 'guys', 'insane', 'crazy', 'literally changed my life', 'you won't believe'
No income claims, guaranteed returns, or earnings figures presented as typical
No fake scarcity, countdowns, or invented testimonials
No medical, legal, or financial advice framed as instruction

cadence.$comment: The pipeline never publishes more than this, whatever the queue holds. Rate limiting is a channel-health decision, not an API concern.

compliance.$comment: Affiliate disclosure is a legal requirement on all three platforms and is appended to every caption automatically.
compliance.affiliateDisclosure: #ad — affiliate link. I earn a commission if you join.
